**Summary of observations:**
- Test image: multiple circular/oval **white to cream spots** of varying sizes on a healthy green corn leaf
- Holcus Spot reference: identical white oval spots on green leaf — strong visual match

The white, circular, scattered spots on an otherwise green leaf are characteristic of **Holcus Spot** (caused by *Pseudomonas syringae*).
